description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Turns a symbol, registry id, fungible-asset address or coin type into one asset, with its on-chain symbol/name/decimals read live. Several different assets share the symbols USDC and USDT (Circle/Tether native vs LayerZero-bridged); those return AMBIGUOUS_INPUT with every candidate, its issuer and how to select it. Assets outside the registry are returned with verified:false, never silently trusted.
